Numerical tests are explicitly not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural smallest non-pair central spectral band on a nonabelian compact group is solved uniformly for every starting weight, not for an isolated sample. Complete sharp constants and optimizer rigidity reveal persistent three-mode mixing and provide a finite-weight correction to a known high-weight parity law. It establishes a parameter-uniform spectral synthesis invariant of potential use as an exact benchmark for nonabelian Fourier estimates.
